name: Basic Memory Cloud
description:
Basic Memory gives you a persistent knowledge base: your notes, decisions, research, and project context, stored as plain Markdown files you own. Anything Claude saves, you can open and edit. Anything you write, Claude can find and build on.

Save what matters.  "Save our pricing decision and link it to the roadmap." Notes you save in one conversation are available everywhere.

Retrieve context from anywhere. "What did we decide about pricing? Check my notes first." Never re-explain a project.

Search by meaning.  Semantic and hybrid search across everything you and your AI have saved.

Structured search. Filter by status, type, tags, or priority. "Show my open tasks, sorted by priority."

Follow connections. Linked notes let Claude traverse related context and surface relationships in a living knowledge graph.

Share a workspace with your team. Teammates and their AI tools read and write to one shared source of truth.

Notes are stored as ordinary Markdown that you own. Any AI tool can use and build on it, so your shared context follows you across the assistants and agents you use.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Basic Memory Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Basic Memory Cloud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://cloud.basicmemory.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Basic Memory Cloud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic Memory Cloud lists 21 MCP tools, including activity_feed, build_context, cloud_info, create_memory_project, delete_note, delete_project, edit_note, list_directory, list_memory_projects, list_workspaces, move_note, and read_content.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Basic Memory Cloud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Basic Memory Cloud in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Basic Memory Cloud MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basic Memory Cloud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Basic Memory Cloud is developed by Basic Memory. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
